youtube-fa.text: با توربودراپ آشنا شوید؛ مثل ایردراپ، برای همهٔ دستگاه‌ها.

youtube-fa.text: برنامه را روی کامپیوتر باز کنید و کد را با گوشی اسکن کنید. گوشی در همان مرورگر، هم می‌فرستد و هم دریافت می‌کند؛ بدون نصب برنامه.
youtube-fa.sub_en: Open the app on your computer and scan the code with your phone. The phone sends and receives right in its browser, with no app to install.

youtube-fa.text: اتصال کامپیوترها با یک کد چهار ایموجی، پیدا کردن خودکار دستگاه‌های نزدیک، عکس‌هایی با پیش‌نمایش، و پوشه‌هایی که ساختارشان حفظ می‌شود.

youtube-fa.text: اگر اتصال قطع شود، از اول شروع نمی‌کند؛ از همان‌جا ادامه می‌دهد.
youtube-fa.sub_en: If the connection drops, it doesn’t start over; it continues from where it stopped.

youtube-en.text: Every day we move files between iPhone, Android, Windows and Mac. It shouldn’t be hard.
Meet Turbodrop: like AirDrop, for every device.
Open the app on your computer and scan the code with your phone. The phone sends and receives right in its browser, with no app to install.
Computers pair with a four‑emoji code, nearby devices are found automatically, photos arrive with previews, and folders keep their structure.
If the connection drops, it doesn’t start over; it continues from where it stopped.
The Windows installer is about four megabytes, and the speed limit is your own network.
End‑to‑end encrypted: no cloud, no account, not even an internet connection.
Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android, in twelve languages.
For developers it has a command line, so AI assistants like Claude Code can send files with it too.
Turbodrop is part of Pouyam Open Source: free tools for developers and the whole world.
Free and open source. The download link is in the description.
